docs.text: Any other lichen lovers out there? I'm always delighted to still see these cool outposts even in subfreezing temps on the shore of Lake Michigan. #naturephotography #naturalist #coolstuff

Taking a trip west across #Canada and starting with Lake Superior with its rugged coastline, tiny Saxifrage clinging to granite corners and bright cushions of Elegant Sunburst Lichen (Xanthoria elegans) ... #NaturePhotography #LakeSuperior #Nature #lakes #granite

LIchen on a tree in Olive Park, next to Lake Michigan in Chicago. The center "square" is less than 1 centimeter on each side. Most people ignore lichens, but they can be very complex and beautiful. This is a focus stack of eight images.

Physcia stellaris/aipolia (or similar) from the shores of Lake Huron, Ontario, Canada.

Collema nigrescens - Blistered Jelly Lichen This one's a goodie. Usually prefers oceanic climates, but will grow inland too if there's a big enough lake (like Lake Superior) with enough humidity.
Rocks, ice, lichen. A few smaller scenes from winter on the Lake Superior shoreline.
trying to work with pastels,,,, this is lake superior rocks and lichen!
I saw a lot of lichen at the lake today

June in Grand Marais Harbor. The Elegant Sunburst Lichen (Rusavskia elegans) is ablaze in the setting sun. Another 6x17 shot in Grand Marais, MN located on Lake Superior. I used a Shen Hao 617 Graflok back on my Shen Hao TZ 45-II B. Ektar 100, lab developed, DSLR scan.
Saw some similarly colorful lichen off of lake Michigan! Such a brilliant orange.

These guys are so familiar to me from the lakeside in Grand Marais, Minnesota, Lake Superior. The shore is so brilliantly orange all year long.
It’s close to the Boundary waters canoe area where I first fell in love with Lichens.
